summary:
Snowflake 營收年增33%強勁，但 EPS 轉虧 0.86 美元且低於預期，獲利路徑仍受投資與競爭壓力拖累。
• 營收 13.9 億美元，年增 33.48%，成長動能強勁
• 資料雲平台與 AI/ML 工作負載需求提升
• Cortex AI 等新產品擴大平台價值主張
• 大型客戶與消費型營收持續累積
ai_view:
訊號喜憂參半：營收高速成長印證資料雲與 AI 需求結構性向上，但 EPS 轉虧且低於預期，凸顯獲利兌現仍待考驗。短期股價可能因獲利不如預期承壓，市場焦點將落在產品收入留存率（NRR）與消費型營收環比動能。中期關鍵在 Cortex AI 變現、毛利率與營業利潤率改善能否與營收成長同步，以支撐無本益比下的高估值預期。

需留意：本期 EPS 轉虧並低於預期，獲利能見度承壓；與 Databricks 等競爭加劇，價格與份額壓力上升；高研發與行銷投入短期壓抑利潤率

summary_en:
Snowflake grew revenue 33% but posted a wider-than-expected $0.86 loss, with profitability still pressured by heavy investment.
• Revenue of $1.39B grew 33.48%, showing strong momentum
• Rising demand for data cloud and AI/ML workloads
• New products like Cortex AI broaden the platform value proposition
• Continued accumulation of large customers and consumption revenue

ai_view_en:
Mixed signal: rapid revenue growth confirms structural demand for data cloud and AI, but the swing to a wider-than-expected loss highlights unproven profitability. Near term the stock may be pressured by the earnings miss, with focus on net revenue retention and sequential consumption momentum. Mid term, the key is whether Cortex AI monetization and margin improvement keep pace with revenue to support a richly valued, currently unprofitable name.

Watch：Swing to a loss that missed estimates pressures profitability visibility; Intensifying competition with Databricks raises pricing and share pressure; High R&D and sales spend weighs on margins near term
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 為 -0.86 美元、差 3.52%，惟營收年增 33.48% 維持高速成長。
